title: Hotel Inhumans Anime's 2nd Season Casts Mitsuki Saiga
content: The official website for the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga revealed on Thursday a new cast member for the anime's second season . Mitsuki Saiga plays Sekiya, a woman who is frequently seen on the train reading books about murder or poison: The new season features returning staff, including…

title: Future Trunks Deserves a Bigger Role in Dragon Ball’s Anime Future
content: Before the Marvel Cinematic Universe became a trend, Dragon Ball Z became one of the forefathers of expanded universes, giving its fans the OG time traveling hero , Future Trunks.

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Casts Natsuko Abe
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga revealed on Thursday that the series has cast Natsuko Abe as Aoi, Satoko's mentor and a courtesan with a gentle demeanor: The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō.
author: ANN

title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster Game's Trailer Reveals May 13 Release in West
content: NIS America announced on Thursday that it will release The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster ( Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu ) game in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam on May 13, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Naruto’s Most Exciting Battle Against Madara Is Getting a New U.S. Release
content: Naruto Shippuden is all set to release Blu-ray Set 12 this November, as confirmed by the official website of Viz Media . Based on Masashi Kishimoto’s iconic Weekly Shonen Jump manga, the anime is just as popular even now thanks to its exceptional storytelling, unique power system, and deeply complex characters.
author: ComicBook

title: FromSoftware Delays The Duskbloods Switch 2 Game to 2027
content: The Duskbloods will launch exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2. There was a Closed Network Test from August 21-23. In the game, players control a Bloodsworn and fight enemies in the world using various weapons and abilities. Players can also form alliances.
author: ANN

title: 3 Coolest Mobile Suits from Gundam Wing After 30 Years
content: The first and arguably most popular Gundam show for American audiences dropped a quarter century ago, and it featured some all-time mobile suits. Mobile Suit Gundam Wing was released through Toonami in 2000 and jettisoned Gundam right to the top of all mecha anime lists.
